ma.reportEvent(Object object)

Incident reporting (minimum version: 24.6.0)

Parameters

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
eventId String Yes Monitoring ID, obtained after creating a new data indicator on the Mini Program Management Platform
eventData Object No Objects that can be serialized. It will be reported to the system together(supported in 24.9.0)

Usage Restrictions

  1. To use this interface, you need to connect to the Mini Program SaaS platform

Sample Code

ma.reportEvent({
  eventId: 'your eventId',
  eventData: {
    'miniAppStartFrom': 'aaa'
  }
});
